description.en: Claude (Anthropic) typefaces for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: Anthropic Sans for the interface, Anthropic Serif for conversation prose and Anthropic Mono for code. The three fonts are bundled inside the plugin, so no system font install is required.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上 Claude（Anthropic）字体：界面用 Anthropic Sans，对话正文用 Anthropic Serif，代码用 Anthropic Mono。三款字体已内置于插件，无需在系统里额外安装。
